I left them to assemble their own solution.|Jedi Masters Yoda and Mace Windu|<ref name="time">The events of "[[Puzzle Peace]]" must take place between 22 BBY&mdash;the year the Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor was introduced according to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}}&mdash;and 19 BBY&mdash;the year Mace Windu died according to {{Film|III}}.</ref>}}
This '''clan war''' took place sometime between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="time" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Er'stacia]]. As they had for centuries, rival clans of the [[Er'stacian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were battling over possession of the [[Venerable One]], or Megalith&mdash;a giant, stone statue representing the mythical forebear of the species. The two clans wore armor signifying their allegiance: red for one side, and green for the other.<ref name="PP">{{Tales|13|Puzzle Peace}}.</ref>

The war reached such pitched status that the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] feared the participants might commit genocide against their rivals. They therefore [[Mission to Er'stacia|dispatched]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to the world to stop the hostilities.<ref name="CSWE II 303">{{CSWECite|III|303|Megalith}}</ref> On the world, Windu finally negotiated an uneasy peace by dicing the Venerable One statue into pieces using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and thus forcing the enemy sides to work together to either divvy up the pieces or reconstruct the monument.<ref name="PP" />
